about: What a shared link may be, read by the bridge (bridge/publish/share.mjs) and repeated by the plugin (src/services/share-link.ts). Both suites check their constants against this file, so a limit changed on one side fails a test on both.
codeWords: three to eight letters a to z, two of them joined by a hyphen for a link with a password; for one without, three of them and a number from 10 to 99, each after a hyphen (the first such links had two words and the number, still read)
